verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Langfuse serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its docs pages (docs.md and other .md URLs). A dedicated docs MCP page also describes pointing Cursor or other AI coding agents at the docs to integrate tracing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually consume llms.txt or the .md docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Use Cursor (or other AI Coding Agent) to automatically integrate Langfuse Tracing into your codebase
